gallery.description:
Loughcrew Passage Tomb cairn T,
The wall on the left is pitted with so-called "cup marks". When the tomb was opened, a large number of chalk balls were found at the base of this stone. These balls fitted the stone precisely; they may represent the stars in the sky.
